title: Norfolk Southern supports Ronald McDonald House, helping Birmingham families stay close during pediatric care
body_markdown:
Through its 2026[Thriving Communities grant program](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/commitments/in-your-community/community-impact/grant-programs) , Norfolk Southern provided $15,000 to Ronald McDonald House of Alabama to adopt a room at its Birmingham location, helping families stay close to their children while they receive pediatric care nearby. The team hosted a ribbon cutting ceremony at the location earlier today.


Norfolk Southern also donated a custom children’s train table outfitted with toy tracks and model NS trains. Employees at the Juniata Locomotive Shop built the table using high-quality lumber from the company’s Brosnan Forest, reflecting the care, craftsmanship and pride Norfolk Southern railroaders bring to their communities.


**Why it matters**


Each year, the 73-room[Ronald McDonald House of Alabama](https://ronaldmcdonaldhouseal.org/) and the Ronald McDonald House Family Room at UAB Women & Infants Center provide more than 20,000 overnight stays. Together, they save families more than $7.4 million in food and lodging expenses, allowing parents and caregivers to focus on what matters most: supporting their children.


**What they’re saying**


“Norfolk Southern is proud to partner with Ronald McDonald House Charities of Alabama to support families when they need it most. The grant and train table reflect the care and pride our railroaders bring to the communities we serve, and we hope both gifts will make a lasting difference for children receiving care and their families.” – Kristin Wong, Director of the Norfolk Southern Foundation and Community Impact.


This latest support builds on Norfolk Southern’s[$450,000 donation to Children’s of Alabama in 2025](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/story-yard/children-s-of-alabama-doubles-critical-care-capacity-with-norfol) , which is helping the hospital double its critical care space and strengthen health care education and simulation training programs.


Together, these investments reflect Norfolk Southern’s commitment to improving the health and well-being of children and families in Birmingham and across the communities it serves.
